evidence: live admission collision on GCE plus hermetic before/after regression
cause: Session starts update the workspace revision and the tenant quota snapshot before atomic queue admission. Concurrent valid starts can read the same revisions; the losing transaction rolls back without a new queue row.

safe_live_reconciliation.action: Retry the identical start with its original key only after confirming no durable operation exists.
safe_live_reconciliation.result: Both native AGY writers were observed running concurrently and completed their initial turns.

hermetic_regression.name: concurrent_named_sessions_admit_once_without_exposing_internal_revision_conflicts
hermetic_regression.implementation: Four barrier-synchronized start calls against the real in-memory SQLite registry. Check unique operations and sessions, then repeat each original request/key and confirm exact operation/session replay.
hermetic_regression.after: Passed, followed by both quota regressions and production/test clippy with warnings denied.

fix: Bounded revalidation retries refresh authorization, workspace state, immutable source selection and tenant quotas. They preserve the request idempotency key and retry only failed internal metadata compare-and-set admission. Native model turns are not replayed.
live_model_boundary: Initial AGY outputs published and previewed. A later continuation policy-inheritance defect remained under investigation at this admission fix; this record does not claim full live workflow completion.
not_done: Real-host admission without client retry on the rebuilt fixed binary
